title: Letter
description: Data for the business letter template (Geschäftsbrief, DIN 5008).

$schema.description: URL or path of this schema, for editor support.

metadata.description: Document metadata shown in the header box.

subject.description: Subject line printed in bold above the salutation.

recipient.description: Recipient of the letter: name, optional company and address, or the address as free lines.

lines.description: Address lines as printed, e.g. company, contact person, street, postal code and city.

salutation.description: Salutation line, e.g. "Sehr geehrter Herr Weber,".

content.description: Letter text as plain text. For headings, lists and tables pass the text as Typst content: letter(data: …, company: …)[…].

closing.description: Closing phrase; defaults to "Mit freundlichen Grüßen".

signature_name.description: Name below the closing; only used together with closing. Falls back to company.business_owner or company.name.

final.description: Last paragraph, kept on one page with the closing and signature. In Typst it may be content.
